info.name: Rings
info.description: Magical Rings from the Aldea Campaign Setting.

p.i: A simple bronze ring with a singular moonstone seated in its head. An unassuming ring, it glows a small white light when in use.

description.p: Within this ring is the soul of a Bashan ghost fox. As an Action, you call forth a ghostly facsimile of the fox, which manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within 60 feet and uses the Ghost Fox stat block. The fox disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or after 1 hour.

The fox is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.
While summoned, the fox provides the following benefits:

ul.li: Hunter's Focus. When you cast the Hunter’s Mark spell, you can choose for the fox to maintain Concentration on the spell instead of you.
Ghostly Scout. You can cast the Beast Sense spell at will, but can only target the ghost fox.

set.name: attunement
set.addition: by a Ranger, Barbarian, or Druid
